instruction:
Snowflake has no `FILTER (WHERE cond)` clause on aggregates. sqlglot already writes one into the aggregated values for Snowflake, `SUM(x) FILTER (WHERE c)` becoming `SUM(IFF(c, x, NULL))`, but gets it wrong when the aggregate also has a WITHIN GROUP clause. Fix the Snowflake output for those:
- ARRAY_AGG and LISTAGG take their values from their (first) argument: wrap that argument and keep the WITHIN GROUP clause.
- PERCENTILE_CONT, PERCENTILE_DISC and MODE are ordered-set aggregates whose values come from the WITHIN GROUP ORDER BY key: wrap the key instead.
- Snowflake's MODE takes its value as an argument and has no WITHIN GROUP form, so `MODE() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v)` is written `MODE(v)`, with or without a FILTER.
- WITHIN GROUP with FILTER on any other function can't be rewritten for Snowflake: report it as unsupported (generation raises UnsupportedError under ErrorLevel.RAISE).
NULL ordering in the WITHIN GROUP clause is written as sqlglot already writes it for the source dialect, and other dialects keep their FILTER clause.
Read with sqlglot's default dialect and written with Snowflake (input -> output):
- SELECT ARRAY_AGG(x) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY y) FILTER(WHERE z > 0) FROM t -> SELECT ARRAY_AGG(IFF(z > 0, x, NULL)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY y NULLS FIRST) FROM t
- SELECT FOO(x) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY y) FILTER(WHERE z > 0) FROM t -> unsupported
Read with DuckDB and written with Snowflake:
- SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY b) FILTER (WHERE a IS NOT NULL) FROM t -> SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY IFF(NOT a IS NULL, b, NULL)) FROM t
- SELECT PERCENTILE_DISC(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY b DESC) FILTER (WHERE b > 0) FROM t -> SELECT PERCENTILE_DISC(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY IFF(b > 0, b, NULL) DESC NULLS LAST) FROM t
- SELECT MODE() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY col) FILTER (WHERE b < 3) FROM t -> SELECT MODE(IFF(b < 3, col, NULL)) FROM t
Read with Redshift and written with Snowflake:
- SELECT LISTAGG(x, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY y) FILTER (WHERE z > 0) FROM t -> SELECT LISTAGG(IFF(z > 0, x, NULL), ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY y) FROM t
Read with PostgreSQL and written with Snowflake:
- SELECT MODE() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x) FROM t -> SELECT MODE(x) FROM t
Add tests.
